apps.name: GainFrame: Gym Progress Photos
apps.store_desc:
See what’s actually changing in your physique.

GainFrame turns progress photos into body-fat estimates, muscle-group insights, side-by-side comparisons, and an AI Coach grounded in your real check-ins—not generic fitness advice.

FROM PHOTO TO PROOF

• Compare any two check-ins side by side
• See body-fat, weight, and physique-score changes together
• Open an AI Deep Dive that explains what changed—and why
• Review 12 muscle groups across front and back poses

AN AI COACH THAT KNOWS YOUR DATA
apps.description: GainFrame shows whether the living-room routine is changing your physique, even without a gym log.
